title: A DeepMind exec finally said what the trillion-dollar AI spend is for: machines that improve themselves.
excerpt: A Google DeepMind exec says the AI capex boom is a bet on recursive self-improvement, and admits today’s revenue cannot justify the spend.
content_html:
Everyone has been asking what the trillion-dollar AI buildout is actually for. A senior Google DeepMind executive has now given an unusually blunt answer. The spending, he says, is a bet on machines that improve themselves.

Jasjeet Sekhon, DeepMind’s chief strategy officer, made the case at a summit at UC Berkeley. Recursive self-improvement, or RSI, is “becoming a key component of the AI investment thesis,” The Information first reported. RSI is the idea of AI that can rewrite and upgrade itself, generating ever more capable successors without humans in the loop.

The striking part is the candour underneath it. Sekhon admitted that AI revenues “don’t sustain the capital expenditures we’re making so far.” The money is being spent, in other words, on a promise. He argued that betting against it would be unwise, since there are already “the makings of RSI.” He offered a neat analogy: steam engines built the next steam engine.

The new north star

What makes the framing land is what it replaces. For years the industry justified its spending by pointing at artificial general intelligence. Sekhon is effectively swapping one distant goal for another. RSI, on this telling, is the new AGI: the payoff that turns today’s data centres from a cost into the most valuable machines ever built.

The scale is real. Alphabet spent $44.9bn on capital projects in a single quarter, roughly double a year earlier, and lifted its 2026 guidance to as much as $205bn. It has promised a “significant” increase again in 2027. Amazon, Microsoft and Meta are all saying the same. Sekhon likened the effort to something bigger than Apollo or the Manhattan Project.

Some of it is clearly working. Google Cloud revenue jumped 82% in the quarter, with a backlog above $500bn. But the bill is enormous, and Alphabet posted its first-ever negative quarterly free cash flow, about $5.9bn in the red. Spending and revenue are moving at very different speeds.

A bet that may not pay

Sekhon named the risk himself. There could be an “AI air pocket,” he warned, where the expenditure happens but the revenue never arrives. That is the quiet fear under every hyperscaler earnings call, said out loud by the person whose job is to justify the outlay.

And RSI is not a shipping product. It is a research hope with real doubts attached: safety, control and technical feasibility. And whether it is even doable on the timeline executives imply, roughly 2027 to 2028. Rivals are already needling DeepMind over whether it has the self-improvement know-how to get there before OpenAI or Anthropic.

There is a modest version of the claim that is already true. Models can now generate code and, in narrow ways, help improve their own. The leap Sekhon is selling is from that to full, autonomous self-enhancement, and it is a large one.

What he has really done is make the trade explicit. The industry is spending Apollo-sized sums today against a capability that does not yet exist, and may not for years. His honesty is refreshing. It is also, if you are an investor, slightly terrifying.

content_html_zh:
每个人都在问数万亿美元的人工智能建设到底是做什么用的。 谷歌 DeepMind 的一位高级高管现在给出了一个异常直率的答案。 他说，这笔支出是对能够自我改进的机器的赌注。

DeepMind 首席战略官 Jasjeet Sekhon 在加州大学伯克利分校的一次峰会上阐述了这一观点。 据《The Information》首先报道，递归自我完善（RSI）正在“成为人工智能投资论文的一个关键组成部分”。 RSI 是人工智能的理念，它可以重写和升级自身，在没有人类介入的情况下产生更有能力的继任者。

最引人注目的部分是其背后的坦诚。 Sekhon 承认人工智能收入“无法维持我们迄今为止的资本支出”。 换句话说，钱是花在承诺上的。 他认为，做空它是不明智的，因为“RSI 的形成”已经存在。 他提供了一个简洁的类比：蒸汽机制造了下一个蒸汽机。

新的北极星

构成框架土地的就是它所取代的东西。 多年来，该行业通过通用人工智能来证明其支出的合理性。 塞洪实际上正在将一个遥远的目标换成另一个。 从这个意义上讲，RSI 是新的 AGI：将当今的数据中心从成本转变为有史以来最有价值的机器的回报。

规模是真实的。 Alphabet 单季度在资本项目上花费了 449 亿美元，大约是去年同期的两倍，并将 2026 年指导目标提高至 2050 亿美元。 它承诺在 2027 年再次“大幅”增长。 亚马逊、微软和 Meta 都这么说。 塞洪将这项努力比作比阿波罗或曼哈顿计划更伟大的事情。

其中一些显然正在发挥作用。 谷歌云本季度收入增长 82%，积压订单超过 5000 亿美元。 但这笔账单数额巨大，Alphabet 首次出现负季度自由现金流，亏损约 59 亿美元。 支出和收入的变化速度截然不同。

可能不会支付的赌注

塞洪自己命名了这种风险。 他警告说，可能存在“人工智能空气袋”，即支出发生但收入永远不会到来。 这是每次超大规模企业财报电话会议上无声的恐惧，负责证明支出合理性的人都会大声说出来。

而且 RSI 不是运输产品。 这是一个带有真正疑问的研究希望：安全性、控制性和技术可行性。 以及高管暗示的时间表（大约 2027 年至 2028 年）是否可行。 竞争对手已经开始质疑 DeepMind 是否拥有先于 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 实现自我提升的专业知识。

这种说法的一个温和版本已经是正确的。 模型现在可以生成代码，并以狭隘的方式帮助改进自己的代码。 Sekhon 所推销的飞跃是从这一点到完全、自主的自我增强，而且是一个很大的飞跃。

他真正所做的就是让交易变得明确。 如今，该行业正在花费阿波罗规模的资金来开发一种尚不存在的能力，而且可能在未来几年内都不存在。 他的诚实令人耳目一新。 如果你是投资者，这也有点可怕。
